about.title: Practical ESG action. Durable business value.
about.intro: As sustainability expectations and reporting requirements by the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria and the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards continue to evolve, we help organisations understand what matters, respond to emerging requirements and embed sustainability into strategy, governance, risk management, operations and reporting.
about.body:
Terratora helps organisations navigate this developing landscape across Nigeria and global markets by translating emerging environmental, social and governance requirements and sustainability trends into practical business action.

We combine technical expertise, strategic insight and implementation support to help organisations strengthen governance, manage sustainability-related risks and opportunities, enhance reporting and build the capabilities needed to adapt and grow.

Our approach goes beyond compliance. We help organisations create durable value while responding to the expectations of investors, creditors, regulators and wider stakeholders, and considering the impact of business on people, communities and the environment.
about.vision: To be Nigeria and Africa’s most trusted independent partner in building credible, investable and future-ready sustainability reporting.
about.mission: We help organisations turn complex ESG and IFRS S1/S2 requirements into clear, practical action by building the governance, data and reporting capability they need to report with confidence, earn stakeholder trust and unlock long-term value.

services.title: From ESG requirements to practical action.
services.intro: We support organisations across the reporting journey, from understanding readiness and evaluating risk to building credible governance, data, controls and reporting capability.

items.title: ESG Readiness Assessment
items.summary: From reporting requirements to a clear path forward.
items.body:
If your organisation does not yet know how prepared it is, our ESG Readiness Assessment provides a clear view of its preparedness for the sustainability reporting requirements of the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria and the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards. Sustainability reporting is moving from voluntary disclosure to a more structured, standards-driven expectation.

We assess current disclosures, governance, processes, data, controls and reporting practices against applicable requirements, identify the gaps between the current and reporting-ready states, and translate those findings into a practical implementation roadmap.

items.title: ESG Reporting Advisory
items.summary: Transform fragmented ESG data into credible, decision-useful reporting.
items.body:
When ESG information is fragmented and the route to reporting is unclear, effective sustainability reporting requires more than collecting data. It requires a framework that connects sustainability performance with business strategy, governance, risk management and financial decision-making.

We translate FRCN and IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards into practical reporting processes and structures, then design the responsibilities, data flows, workflows, controls and reporting architecture needed to produce consistent, reliable and scalable disclosures.

items.title: Supply Chain Evaluation
items.summary: See beyond your suppliers. Understand risks across your value chain.
items.body:
If you need better visibility into suppliers and related risks, sustainability performance does not stop at organisational boundaries. Suppliers can influence climate exposure, resource dependencies, labour and human-rights risks, regulatory obligations and broader sustainability performance.

We assess suppliers against relevant environmental, social and governance criteria using questionnaires, documentation, available data and defined evaluation methodologies to identify material risks, information gaps, areas of strength and opportunities for improvement.

items.title: Governance and Internal Controls Review
items.summary: Build the governance and controls behind credible ESG reporting.
items.body:
Where ESG responsibilities, processes or controls are unclear, credible sustainability reporting starts with strong governance. We assess how oversight, data and reporting processes operate from the board and executive team to the functions generating sustainability information.

Our review covers governance structures, roles and accountability, policies and procedures, data ownership, reporting processes, internal controls and escalation mechanisms, then turns identified gaps into practical improvements.

items.title: Implementation Support
items.summary: Move identified gaps to embedded capability.
items.body:
Identifying ESG gaps is one part of the compliance journey; implementation is another. Building on our assessments and advisory engagements, we work with management to implement the frameworks, documentation and processes required for credible and compliant sustainability disclosures.

Support can cover policies and procedures, governance frameworks, data ownership protocols, reporting processes, disclosure matrices, controls documentation, reporting templates and implementation roadmaps.

items.title: Board-Level Training
items.summary: Equip leaders to make informed decisions in a changing ESG landscape.
items.body:
ESG increasingly influences strategy, risk, capital allocation, reporting and stakeholder expectations. Our concise, tailored and decision-oriented briefings are designed around the organisation’s sector, geographic footprint, reporting obligations and strategic priorities.

We translate developments in FRCN and IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, climate-related risks and opportunities, ESG governance, emerging regulation and market expectations into practical insight for directors and executives.

items.title: Sustainability Training
items.summary: Build ESG capability across your organisation.
items.body:
Sustainability increasingly extends across finance, risk, governance, operations, procurement, strategy and corporate reporting. Our programmes translate complex ESG concepts, IFRS Sustainability Standards and emerging requirements into clear, practical and business-relevant learning.

We combine a common sustainability foundation with role-specific training tailored to your industry, reporting requirements, organisational priorities and level of ESG maturity.
